Notes: Ships with the Intuos 2026 (CTK-4120 / CTK-6120), announced 2026-09-29; first recorded under the placeholder PenId LITE-PEN until its model code was published. Specs from Wacom China's spec sheet: tapers from 10.4 mm to 9 mm in diameter, 160 mm long excluding the lanyard loop, comes with 5 standard POM nibs, and also takes Pro Pen 3 POM, carbon-shaft POM, felt and carbon-shaft rubber nibs.
